name: Alila Solo
positioning: City hotel of eight staggered towers above a main avenue in Solo (Surakarta), Central Java, with a spa, a rooftop lounge and local cultural experiences
best_for: Travelers exploring the royal city of Solo and Javanese crafts such as batik
Couples wanting a suite with a private plunge pool and terrace

facts.text: Alila Solo rises above a main avenue in Solo known for dining and retail.
Solo, also known as Surakarta, is the older of the two royal capitals of Central Java and preserves walled royal palaces.
The high-ceilinged lobby features batik-inspired art.
Some rooms have a mountain view and a bathroom with a rainfall shower.
Spa Alila has therapeutic pools and herbal-infused steam rooms.
Spa Alila's therapists are local and trained in anatomical physiology, massage and meditation.
The Largo pool area is an open, tree-dotted space with loungers and sofa pods.
The main restaurant, Epice, serves farm-to-table dining with Javanese and Western accents.
The Studio Sessions experience lets guests record a song at the Lokananta recording studio and take the recording home.
A morning experience visits the Pasar Gede market in Solo.

highlights.text: The rooms and suites are spread across eight towers of staggered heights.
The Alila Suite has a private plunge pool, a private terrace and a luxury bathroom with a rain shower.
The Harvest Bliss experience takes guests to the rice paddies of Klaten to plant, harvest and catch fish by hand.
The Threads and Blades experience explores batik and keris, visiting the house of Go Tik Swan and a master keris smith.
AGRA is a rooftop lounge with an indoor area and an outdoor terrace, offering cocktails, live music and DJ sets.

considerations.text: Access to the Sky Lounge on Level 30 is for guests in Deluxe rooms and suites.
The 9th-century Borobudur temple is about two hours from Solo.
WhataHotel notes limited recreational facilities compared to resort properties.
